verdict.rationale: The README offers per-harness Getting Started sections for Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex App/CLI, Cursor, Devin CLI, Factory Droid, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and OpenCode, and states that installation differs by harness. The docs say `skills/` is the harness-agnostic source of truth shared verbatim, with per-harness tool mappings and bootstrap injectors. Release notes add Devin, Hermes, Grok and Antigravity installs, and a real install probe plus a community account of the Codex/OpenCode install path corroborate it. Missing for 10: the content of the Cursor-specific instructions is not shown beyond its listing, and there is no hands-on install verification for harnesses other than Claude Code.
